week.name: Saturday
week.short: Slight Chance Snow Showers then Partly Sunny
week.detailed: A slight chance of snow showers before 8am, then a slight chance of snow between 8am and 11am. Partly sunny. High near 37, with temperatures falling to around 33 in the afternoon. South southeast wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 41. East wind 0 to 3 mph.

week.detailed: A chance of snow before 11am, then a chance of rain and snow between 11am and 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 39. Chance of precipitation is 40%.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 41.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Slight Chance Light Snow

week.detailed: A slight chance of snow before 11am, then a chance of rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 44.

week.name: Friday

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 21 at 5:05AM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow showers continue across the Wasatch mainly north of the
I-84 corridor this morning. Additional snow accumulations of 1 to 2
inches expected.

* WHERE...Wasatch Mountains I-80 North.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 3–8 in. over the next 7 days (middle 4 in.), and they roughly agree. About 2 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 2 in. for the week.
